XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Unable to start the engine, instrument panel malfunction
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: 7233 | INJECTION | ELECTRONICS | 923A67 | SWITCHES OFF | SWITCHING OFF | DOES NOT START | DOES NOT START | IGNITION | DISPLAY | BLACK SCREEN | CONTROLS | MULTIFUNCTION | MULTIMEDIA | LOCK | DOES NOT RESPOND |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured from 01/01/19 to 17/01/22

  • System: Injection

  • Device: Alliance Intelligent Current Sensor (AIBS)

  • Fault: Sudden engine shutdown, unable to start engine, malfunction of instrument panel multimedia screen

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: 923A67

  • Cause: Faulty intelligent current sensor (AIBS)

• Action: Replace the Alliance Intelligent Current Sensor (AIBS)

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Ensure that the new Alliance Intelligent Current Sensor (AIBS) has product code 250820499R, with index "- - E" or later.
